rationale: Trump's announcement that the planned triumphal arch will double as a military ammunition storage complex represents a new domestic policy development affecting Washington DC.

top_events.title: Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition
top_events.label: Trump arch to store military ammunition
top_events.summary: Trump announced updated plans for his triumphal arch in Washington DC to include military ammunition storage. The president said the change was at the military's request for national security.

top_events.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
top_events.label: Ukraine fires 450 drones at Moscow
top_events.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow with 450 drones downed and two deaths. The distant foreign escalation has minimal direct impact on US daily life.

top_events.title: Journalists denied White House access after Trump banned some media outlets
top_events.label: White House confiscates press badges
top_events.summary: CNN, MSNOW, and Politico reporters had their White House press badges confiscated. The media access restriction continues Trump's ongoing press confrontation.

short_summary: US Denmark Greenland security deal signed

most_significant_event.label: US Denmark Greenland security deal signed
most_significant_event.summary: Trump claims permanent US security control over Greenland under new agreement with Denmark, though Danish officials have not confirmed specifics. Shifts US Arctic military posture and NATO.
most_significant_event.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
